hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Leg isolation valves (lower valve of each leg)
function: The lower hydraulic valve on each vertical leg that, with the working valve above it, gives two closed valves between the spread and a well that has wireline or coiled tubing in the hole.

tabs.overview: Stays open on wells in the frac rotation so the working valve alone cycles the well on and off the spread. Closed and verified before the neighbor is pumped when this well has tools in the hole, and closed for any work on the working valve or the spools above it.
tabs.engineering: Same valve family and bore as the working valve; hydraulic with position indication.
tabs.safety: Both leg valves confirmed closed on the control unit before wireline enters the well; positions are part of the pre-pump check.
tabs.evidence: Frac manifold and isolation patents (S31, S32), vertical zipper product page (S33), API 6A for the valves (S1), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
